Ligatured monospace. This Windows-bundled copy's embedded nameID13 carries a Microsoft "supplied font" notice rather than plain OFL text, while nameID14 still resolves to the OFL FAQ URL; the canonical GitHub repo's LICENSE file is unambiguous, so that is the cited source. Missing U+2300 diameter sign. EXCLUDED FOR REDUNDANCY, NOT FOR LICENCE -- the licence and the presence findings above both stand. Measured 2026-09-22: this file and CascadiaMono.ttf are the same design and, for everything this project reads, the same bytes. Their glyf, loca, hmtx, cmap, cvt, fpgm, prep, gasp, hhea, maxp and post tables are byte-identical; all 186 covered charset classes draw from identical outlines at identical advances; and the 35 rendered benchmark pages per corpus were byte-identical. The only differing tables are GSUB (Code's programming ligatures), name, OS/2 panose, head checksum and DSIG -- and OCRcer renders isolated codepoints with no shaping, so the ligature layer that is the entire difference between the two files can never reach the bank. Keeping both spent 930 of 18540 prototypes (5.0%) on bitwise duplicates. Excluded rather than local-only so a --local build does not reintroduce the duplicate. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 11, 2026-09-22, and docs/measurements/2026-09-22_cascadia_duplicate_face.txt.
